subject: Hosted cost / headroom confirmation — monthly token shape + peak spec
content:
From: Emma Liu <emma@averon.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: traffic shape + target $/1M — requested follow-up

Hi Kimberly — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the numbers we promised to share from our side so you can confirm hosted pricing options that fit our target budget.

High-level product: Averon is building a clinical triage assistant (primary NLU + conditional generation). Main characteristics: short prompts (1–2 turns), mix of generation (75%) and embeddings/rerank (25%).

Traffic snapshot (monthly expectations):
- Active users (monthly): ~120k
- Avg tokens per active user / month: ~260 => baseline monthly tokens ~31.2M
- Seasonal uplift windows: two short spikes / day when batch-analysis runs kick in (each spike ~2–4 minutes)
- 95th percentile sustained TPS: ~210 qps
- Burst peak observed in logs: ~680 qps (2–4 minutes), occurs during batch windows

Business constraint: target cost of goods ~ $20–$28 per 1M tokens (we can flex with committed volume).

Ask from Redwood:
1) Hosted pricing bands that would meet target $/1M for both baseline and committed tiers
2) Whether the 680 qps 2–4 minute bursts push us to Dedicated or if hosted with burst gating is acceptable
3) Any immediate red flags on request mix or KV/cache assumptions that materially change cost

Attached: averon-traffic-breakdown.csv (sample day + burst windows).

Happy to hop on a 20-min call if useful — available 8/22 morning PT.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Product
Averon Health
emma@averon.ai

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@averon.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 17:10:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: traffic shape + target $/1M — requested follow-up

Emma — really helpful numbers, thanks for the CSV. High-level thoughts below and a small set of clarifying questions so we can narrow a hosted pricing proposal that stays in your target $/1M band.

Quick clarifications (will materially affect unit economics):
- Confirmed mix: 75% generation (streaming) and 25% embeddings/rerank (batch). Is that ratio stable or does it vary by environment (prod vs nightly analytics)?
- For the "avg tokens per active user" number — is the 260 tokens including system + user + assistant tokens? (helps with per-request token accounting)
- For the bursts: are the ~680 qps spikes predominantly short-lived single-token increments (KV cache hits) or full-sequence generations?

Preliminary hosted sizing and pricing buckets (ballpark; we will refine with Marissa):
- Option A (no commit): pay-as-you-go hosted — expect ~$34 / 1M tokens at your mix and peak gating enabled. Good for fast testing but above your target band.
- Option B (3–6 month commit): committed band for 30–75M tokens / month => estimated $21–$25 / 1M tokens. Requires a soft monthly commit and committed concurrency profile (helps us reserve capacity).
- Option C (annual committed): deeper discount if you commit >=360M tokens / year => ~$15–$19 / 1M tokens plus priority burst allowance.

Important note on bursts: hosted supports short burst headroom via automatic burst gating and regional fallbacks — for the 680 qps 2–4 minute bursts you described, hosted is often acceptable if the bursts are cache-friendly (high KV hit) and if you accept brief queueing/latency tailing. If bursts are entirely full generations, we typically recommend a Dedicated pool for predictable SLA and no burst throttling.

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa will calculate a worked example for Option B (3-month commit) with your 31M/mo baseline and two daily spikes; she will produce a per-month invoice estimate and $/1M target.
- Karthik — can you weigh in on whether a small Dedicated pool (for predictable burst headroom) is warranted for a 680 qps 3–4 minute burst, or whether we should optimize caching/batching first?
- Emma — if you can confirm the three clarifications above by EOD or tomorrow morning PT, we can send a formal hosted proposal before our follow-up call.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment references: averon-traffic-breakdown.csv (received)

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@averon.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 09:02:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: traffic shape + target $/1M — requested follow-up

Kerning in with a concrete pricing worksheet (attached) and a technical recommendation.

Summary recommendation: start with hosted Option B (3-month commit) + a small burst reserve (ephemeral slack) we can enable in the region. Rationale:
- Your monthly baseline (~31M tokens) with 75/25 mix and our default batching assumptions maps to ~22–24 $/1M on a conservative estimate (Marissa will post the worked numbers).
- For the short 680 qps spikes: if we can confirm at least 60% of those are KV-cache friendly / short-context hits then hosted will absorb via burst headroom and prefix caching. If not, a dedicated N1 pool sized for the 680 qps peak will add predictable cost but is only recommended if you require hard latency SLOs during bursts.

Concrete pricing options (workbook attached: redwood-hosted-pricing-bands.pdf):
- Hosted Option B (3-month): commit range 30–50M tokens/month => $22 / 1M tokens (est). Credit terms: net 30; 10% prepay option for slightly better pricing.
- Hosted Option B+ (3-month + burst reserve): $24 / 1M tokens + monthly burst-reserve fee to reserve ephemeral concurrency for scheduled windows.
- Dedicated starter: monthly base + reserved GPUs => equivalent effective $/1M depends on utilization; typically >$28/1M unless you fully commit higher throughput.

Ask for Emma: please confirm the CSV callouts about cache-hit % in bursts. If you can share a 48-hour raw trace (anonymized) Marissa can model actual batch windows and we can firm up $/1M to the nearest dollar.

If Emma is available, I can do a 20-minute call Thursday morning PT to run through the workbook.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions (Americas), Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Attachment references: redwood-hosted-pricing-bands.pdf

Subject: Re: Post-demo: traffic shape + target $/1M — requested follow-up

Thanks all — this is helpful and aligns with our expectations. We will:
- Confirm cache-hit % on the 8/17 sample (should be ~65% for burst windows) and post the 48-hour anonymized trace to the Drive link by EOD.
- For speed, we prefer starting with Hosted Option B (3-month commit at the lower $/1M band) and enabling the burst-reserve for the scheduled windows. That keeps us within our procurement timeline.

Let's take the 20-min call 8/23 9:00am PT to finalize the band and next steps — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Emma
